scope: Model source-fidelity judgments against the supplied text, disclosed after author preference collection. They are not external truth verification or an automatic override of preference.

audit_findings.detail: The opening retains that the father grew up in Boston but omits that he was born there.
“As I worked on those systems” supplies a specific setting for developing concern about judgment that the original’s “Over time” does not establish.
“an argument I first encountered in” the report adds a first-encounter claim absent from the original, which says that argument stayed with the author from the report.
The Google passage says SEO junk piggybacks “on both” self-preferencing links and ads; the original says “on the former,” referring to the self-preferencing links.
